steps.body: Fourteen, fifteen, sixteen say their secret out loud: FOUR-teen, FIF-teen, SIX-teen — the ones first, then “teen” for the ten.
steps.narration: Fourteen, fifteen, sixteen say their secret out loud: FOUR-teen, FIF-teen, SIX-teen — the ones first, then “teen” for the ten.

widget.prompt: A full group of 10 is already shown. Add the extra dots needed to make 15.

commonCounts.feedback: 0 leaves 5 dots still missing — the ten alone only makes 10, not 15.
4 leaves 1 dot still missing; ten and 4 is 14, one short of 15.
6 adds 1 too many; ten and 6 is 16, one past 15.

widget.missFeedback: The ten is done; count on from 10 while adding dots, and stop when you reach 15.
widget.successFeedback: 15 built — one complete ten and 5 more, exactly what the teen numeral says.

predict.prompt: What does the “four” in fourteen count?

options.label: The four ones past the ten

predict.reveal: The -teen ending carries the ten; the front of the word counts only the extras.

cml.actionGoal: Build one complete ten, then count on the ones, for knb 14 16.
invariants: Every teen number is one complete ten and some ones — the left digit records the finished ten, the right digit counts the extras — and that split is what knb 14 16 rests on.
misconceptions: Reading the 1 of a teen as “one” instead of one TEN, or counting only the leftover ones and forgetting the completed ten.
cml.counterfactualPrompt: If one more dot joined the ones, which teen would the frame show then?

widget.successFeedback: 16 built — one complete ten and 6 more, exactly what the teen numeral says.

widget.prompt: Start at 10 and count on 6. Tap where you land.

commonLandings.feedback: 15 stops one complete hop too soon. Continue the final 1-unit hop to reach 16.
17 goes one complete hop too far. Count just 6 hops from 10 to land on 16.

widget.missFeedback: Count 6 on from 10: you land on 16.
widget.successFeedback: 10 and 6 more is 16 — the teen numeral written as a walk: ten first, then the ones.
widget.lowFeedback: Short of the landing — all 6 counts past ten are needed to reach 16.
widget.highFeedback: Past the landing — the count-on stops after 6 numbers, on 16.
